tickets.title: Prepare business cash runway and owner draw framework
tickets.text: Prepare a forward-looking cash runway and owner draw framework for Janelle Thimblefern's Cloudberry Kite Studio, separating signed retainer revenue, possible project revenue, recurring software subscriptions, contractor costs, tax set-asides, and planned owner draws to show how long the business can operate without drawing from the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable portfolio.
tickets.evidence: Janelle asked for a forward-looking view that separates signed retainer revenue, possible project revenue, recurring software subscriptions, contractor costs, tax set-asides, and planned owner draws so she can see how long the business can operate without drawing from the taxable portfolio.

tickets.title: Reconcile bookkeeping balance against Teacup Comet Bank
tickets.text: Reconcile the Cloudberry Kite Studio bookkeeping dashboard balance for Janelle Thimblefern against the Teacup Comet Bank business checking account, resolving the two client deposits marked as received but not yet settled in the bank account.
tickets.evidence: the bookkeeping dashboard showed a higher available business balance than the Teacup Comet Bank business checking account because two client deposits were marked as received even though they had not settled in the bank account. The agreed reconciliation work is due 2024-12-31.

tickets.title: Separate business card feed from household tracker
tickets.text: Separate the Teacup Comet Bank business card feed for Janelle Thimblefern's Cloudberry Kite Studio from the household spending tracker so contractor platform fees and design software charges no longer appear in personal spending categories.
tickets.evidence: For business card feed separation, the Teacup Comet Bank business card feed is importing into the household spending tracker, causing contractor platform fees and design software charges to appear in personal spending categories. The agreed follow-up is due 2025-01-03.

tickets.title: Coordinate quarterly tax reserve with Paper Otter Tax
tickets.text: Coordinate the first quarterly self-employment tax reserve estimate with Janelle Thimblefern's CPA Harper Nettlewhisk of Paper Otter Tax, providing projected gross receipts, expected deductible categories, planned owner draws, and Omar Thimblefern's withholding information for Cloudberry Kite Studio.
tickets.evidence: Harper requested projected gross receipts, expected deductible categories, Janelle’s planned owner draws, and Omar’s withholding information so the first self-employment tax reserve target can be estimated before the initial payment cycle for the new year. The agreed follow-up is due 2025-01-17.

tickets.title: Collect tax documents
tickets.text: Obtain signed W-9 forms and written scopes of work from the two design subcontractors for Janelle Thimblefern's Cloudberry Kite Studio so the next payment batch has complete vendor records for the files.
tickets.evidence: For subcontractor payment records, two design subcontractor invoices in the business folder did not include signed W-9 forms or written scopes of work, and the next payment batch depends on having complete vendor records for the files; this remains an unresolved need due 2025-01-08.
